examples.text: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitan'ti.
taṃ nūna soṇiṃ puthulaṃ sukoṭṭitaṃ, nisevitaṃ kañcanamekhalāhi, chinnaṃ vane khattiyehī avatthaṃ, siṅgālasaṅghā parikaḍḍhissanti.

46703.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of puthula

examples.text: puthulato pana diyaḍḍharatanaṃ dvīsu passesu ratanamatt'ānucaṅkamaṃ dīghato saṭṭhihatthaṃ mudutalaṃ sama-vippakiṇṇa-vālukaṃ caṅkamaṃ vaṭṭati cetiyagirimhi dīpappasādaka-mahindattherassa caṅkamanaṃ viya, tādisaṃ taṃ ahosi.

46705.commentary: (THIa) mā puthulomo'va baḷisaṃ gilitvā'ti āmisalobhena baḷisaṃ gilitvā byasanaṃ pāpuṇanto puthulomo'ti laddhanāmo maccho viya kāme apariccajitvā mā pacchā vihaññasi pacchā vighāṭaṃ āpajjasi.

examples.text: mā appakassa hetu, kāmasukhassa vipulaṃ jahī sukhaṃ, mā puthulomo'va baḷisaṃ, gilitvā pacchā vihaññasi.

46706.meaning1: with a great noise; make a cacophony

examples.text: puthusaddo samajano, na bālo koci maññatha, saṅghasmiṃ bhijjamānasmiṃ, n'āññaṃ bhiyyo amaññaruṃ.

46707.meaning1: other doctrines of different ascetics and Brahmans; alternate beliefs of various monks and priests
46707.sanskrit: pṛthu, pṛthak + śramaṇa + brāhmaṇa + para + pravāda

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañ'c'eva āyatiñ'ca sukhavipākaṃ tadaññe puthu-samaṇabrāhmaṇa-parappavāde abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate cā'ti.

46708.meaning1: doctrines of different ascetics and Brahmans; pronouncements of various monks and priests
46708.commentary: (ANa) aññesaṃ puthu-samaṇabrāhmaṇā-ppavādānan'ti ye aññesaṃ puthūnaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ laddhisaṅkhātappavādā, tesaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bho, puriso aggarasaparititto na aññesaṃ hīnānaṃ rasānaṃ piheti, evam'evaṃ kho, bho, yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti, yadi suttaso, yadi geyyaso, yadi veyyākaraṇaso, yadi abbhutadhammaso, tato tato na aññesaṃ puthu-samaṇabrāhmaṇa-ppavādānaṃ piheti.

46709.meaning1: doctrines of different ascetics and Brahmans; beliefs of various monks and priests

examples.text: kesakambalo, bhikkhave, sīte sīto, uṇhe uṇho, dubbaṇṇo, duggandho, dukkhasamphasso. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, yāni kānici puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇavādānaṃ makkhalivādo tesaṃ paṭikiṭṭho akkhāyati.

46710.meaning1: many different ascetics and Brahmans; various monks and priests
46710.construction:
puthu + samaṇā + brāhmaṇa + ā
puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇa + ā

examples.text: tiṭṭhat'esā, bho gotama, amhākañ'c'eva aññesañ'ca puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vācā. vilāpaṃ vilapitaṃ maññe.
api nu tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vata kotūhalamaṅgalāni tāni sārato paccāgaccheyyāthā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
yo hi koci manussesu, puthusippena jīvati, evaṃ vāseṭṭha jānāhi, sippiko so na brāhmaṇo.

46712.meaning1: various professions; different kinds of work
46712.construction:
puthu + sippa + āyatana + āni
puthusippāyatana + āni

examples.text: yathā nu kho imāni, bhante, puthusipp'āyatanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsikaputtā āḷārikā kappakā nhāpakā sūdā mālākārā rajakā pesakārā naḷakārā
seyyathā'pi, gāmaṇi, puriso mahatiṃ puthusilaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puthusilā dvedhābhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti. evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye āneñjasaṃyojane se bhinne.

46714.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of puthu

examples.text: aññaṃ ito y'ābhivadanti dhammaṃ, aparaddhā suddhim'akevalī te, evam'pi titthyā puthuso vadanti, sandiṭṭhirāgena hi te'bhirattā.

46715.meaning1: attached to many; (or) attached to by many
46715.commentary: (ANa) puthū'ti bahū. sitā'ti upanibaddhā abhisaṅkhatā. atha vā puthussitā'ti puthubhāvaṃ sitā upagatā, puthūhi vā sitā'ti'pi puthussitā.

examples.text: ye kec'ime vādapathā puthussitā, yaṃ nissitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca, tathāgataṃ patvā na te bhavant, visāradaṃ vādapath'ātivattaṃ.
mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratanagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā naragaṇasaṅghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.
idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā tattha subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.

46719.meaning1: in many ways; in different ways; variously

examples.text: anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
parassa ce vambhayitena hīno, na koci dhammesu visesi assa, puthū hi aññassa vadanti dhammaṃ, nihīnato sam'hi daḷhaṃ vadānā.
puthūsīhā'va sallīnā, lomahaṃs'ābhisambhuno, odātamanasā suddhā, vippasanna'm'anāvilā.
gahakāraka diṭṭho'si, puna gehaṃ na kāhasi, sabbā te phāsukā bhaggā, gahakūṭaṃ visaṅkhataṃ, visaṅkhāragataṃ cittaṃ, taṇhānaṃ khayamajjhagā.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso manuññabhojanaṃ bhuttāvī chaḍḍeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu tassa purisassa tasmiṃ vante puna bhottu'kamyatā assā'ti?

46722.meaning1: and what is more; and so too

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhuno sotena saddaṃ sutvā
puna caparaṃ, sīha, dāyako dānapati yaṃ yadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado'va upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.

46723.meaning2: Chapter 15 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

46724.sanskrit: punar + eṣaṇa, eṣaṇā + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

46725.meaning2: Chapter 17 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

46726.meaning2: Chapter 18 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

46727.sanskrit: punar + ogha, augha + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

46728.meaning1: (of a legal case) further action; re-opening; relooking at
46728.commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.3) punakammāya ukkoṭeyyā'ti, akataṃ kammaṃ dukkaṭaṃ kammaṃ punakātabbaṃ kammaṃ anihataṃ dunnihataṃ puna nihanitabbaṃ'ti ukkoṭeti

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihat'ādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

46729.grammar: ptp of puna karoti, comp vb
46729.meaning1: should be done again; ought to be redone; should be repeated

examples.text: punakammāya ukkoṭeyyā'ti, akataṃ kammaṃ dukkaṭaṃ kammaṃ punakātabbaṃ kammaṃ anihataṃ dunnihataṃ puna nihanitabbaṃ'ti ukkoṭeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

46731.meaningLit: another discourse on the Ganges river, etc.
46731.sanskrit: punar + gaṅgā + nadī + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

46732.meaning2: Chapter 14 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
46732.meaningLit: another section on the Ganges with elided repetitions

examples.text: te raññā paṭikkhittā ekam'antaṃ apakkamma evaṃ samacintesuṃ, na kho etaṃ amhākaṃ patirūpaṃ, yaṃ mayaṃ imāni sāpateyyāni puna'd'eva sakāni gharāni paṭihareyyāma.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājañña, api nu tassa purisassa sunhātassa suvilittassa sukappitakesamassussa āmukkamāl'ābharaṇassa odātavatthavasanassa uparipāsādavaragatassa pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitassa samaṅgībhūtassa paricārayamānassa puna'd'eva tasmiṃ gūthakūpe nimujjitu'kāmatā

46737.commentary: (VIN 2.5.5.7) punapavāraṇā'pi sāditabbā'ti yadā gilāno bhavissāmi tadā viññāpessāmī'ti.

examples.text: agilānena bhikkhunā catumāsappaccayapavāraṇā sāditabbā aññatra punapavāraṇāya, aññatra niccapavāraṇāya. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

46738.meaning1: once again; and again; once more

examples.text: gattāni parimajjitvā, puna'p'āruyha caṅkamaṃ, caṅkame caṅkamiṃ so'haṃ, ajjhattaṃ susamāhito.

46739.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of punappuna

examples.text: puññañ'ce puriso kayirā, kayirāth'etaṃ punappunaṃ, tamhi chandaṃ kayirātha, sukho puññassa uccayo.
yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham'upeti mando, tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, dukkhassa jātippabhav'ānupassī.

46742.meaning1: coming again and again; repeatedly coming

examples.text: kiṃsu harantaṃ vārenti, haranto pana ko piyo, kiṃsu punappun'āyantaṃ, abhinandanti paṇḍitā'ti.

46743.meaning2: Chapter 16 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: tuṇhī uttarike hohi, tuṇhī hohi punabbasu, yāv'āhaṃ buddhaseṭṭhassa, dhammaṃ sossāmi satthuno.

46746.meaning1: name of a monk; one of the group of six monks

46747.meaning2: name of one of the group of six monks

examples.text: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti. atha kho punabbasumātā yakkhinī puttake evaṃ tosesi

46750.meaning1: appearing again; renewed existence; rebirth; future life
46750.commentary: (MNa) n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti idāni me puna paṭisandhi nāma n'atthī'ti evaṃ paccavekkhaṇañāṇam'pi me uppannan'ti dasseti. (SNa) n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti idāni puna añño bhavo nāma n'atthī'ti.

examples.text: yassa kho brāhmaṇa āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhava-abhinibbatti pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā tam'ahaṃ apagabbho'ti vadāmi
ñāṇañ'ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi. akuppā me vimutti, ayam'antimā jāti, n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti

46753.meaning1: production of renewed existence; birth of renewed becoming

examples.text: tatra kallaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ, viññāṇ'āhāro āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbattiyā paccayo, tasmiṃ bhūte sati saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso'ti.

yañ'ca, bhikkhave, ceteti yañ'ca pakappeti yañ'ca anuseti, ārammaṇam'etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā. ārammaṇe sati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa hoti. tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti hoti.

46755.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of punabhava

examples.text: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto bhagavantaṃ'y'eva tāṇaṃ gavesī bhagavantaṃ'y'eva leṇaṃ gavesī bhagavantaṃ'y'eva saraṇaṃ gavesī, upanisīditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kim'etaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo āha? punabhavaṃ gotamo bravitū'ti.

46756.commentary: (SNa) punarāgacchate'ti vibbhamanavasena āgacchati. (THa) punarāgacchate idhā'ti idha gehe puna'd'eva āgacchati, hīnāy'āvattanaṃ sandhāya vadati.

examples.text: na kho pana so, sāriputta, saṃsāro sulabharūpo yo mayā asaṃsaritapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, aññatra suddh'āvāsehi devehi. suddh'āvāse c'āhaṃ, sāriputta, deve saṃsareyyaṃ, na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punarāgaccheyyaṃ.

46757.commentary: (ANa) punarāgatā'ti puna jātiṃ puna jaraṃ puna byādhiṃ puna maraṇaṃ āgatā nāma honti. (THa) punarāgatā'ti puna'd'eva upagatā. (JAa) punarāgato'ti imāni tīṇi kāraṇāni disvā puna āgato, ra-kāro sandhivasena vutto.

examples.text: so tena kammena divaṃ samakkami, sukhañ'ca khiḍḍāratiyo ca anvabhi, tato cavitvā punarāgato idha, kos'ohitaṃ vindati vatthachādiyaṃ.

46758.commentary: (DNa) punarāyu ca me laddho'ti puna aññena kammavipākena me jīvitaṃ laddhan'ti, iminā attano cutabhāvaṃ c'eva upapannabhāvañ'ca āvikaroti.

examples.text: idh'eva tiṭṭhamānassa, devabhūtassa me sato, punarāyu ca me laddho, evaṃ jānāhi mārisa.

46759.meaning1: come here again; returned here once more

examples.text: caviya punaridh'āgato samāno, paṭilabhati idha tīṇi lakkhaṇāni, bhavati vipuladīghapāsaṇhiko, brahmā'va suju subho sujātagatto.

46762.synonym: āgacchati, upanivattati, paccāgacchati, pacceti, paṭikkamati, punarāgamati, punāyāti, punupeti
46762.commentary: (THIa) na'y'idaṃ punarehisī'ti oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānena idaṃ kāmaṭṭhānaṃ kāmabhavaṃ paṭisandhivasena puna n'āgamissasi. ra-kāro padasandhikaro. itthan'ti vā pāḷi, itthattaṃ kāmabhavam'icc'eva attho.

examples.text: saṃyojanāni etāni, pajahitvāna bhikkhunī, orambhā'gamanīyāni, na'y'idaṃ punarehisi.
yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.

46764.commentary: (THIa) na'y'idaṃ punarehisī'ti oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānena idaṃ kāmaṭṭhānaṃ kāmabhavaṃ paṭisandhivasena puna n'āgamissasi. rakāro padasandhikaro.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, anuruddhā, tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo punavirūḷhiyā, evam'eva kho, anuruddhā, tathāgatassa ye āsavā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā, pahīnā te ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā

46768.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of puna

examples.text: so karohi dīpam'attano, khippaṃ vāyama paṇḍito bhava, niddhantamalo anaṅgaṇo, na punaṃ jātijaraṃ upehisi.
muñca pure muñca pacchato, majjhe muñca bhavassa pāragū, sabbattha vimuttamānaso, na punaṃ jātijaraṃ upehisi.

[maraṇena'pi te… pabbajjāyā'ti vākyadvayaṃ sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu dutiyaṭṭhāne y'eva dissati, pārājikapāḷiyaṃ pana paṭhamaṭṭhāne y'eva dissati. tasmā idha dutiyaṭṭhāne pun'āgataṃ adhikaṃ viya dissati]

46772.grammar: aor of punāgacchati, comp vb, trans (+acc)

examples.text: satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvesiṃ. satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punāgamāsiṃ. saṃvaṭṭamāne sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, loke ābhassar'ūpago homi, vivaṭṭamāne loke suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjāmi.

46773.grammar: aor of punāgacchati, comp vb, trans (+acc)
46773.meaning1: returned again (to); came back again; was reborn (in)

examples.text: passa puññānaṃ vipākaṃ, kusalānaṃ sukh'esino, mettaṃ cittaṃ vibhāvetvā, satta vassāni bhikkhavo, sattasaṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe, na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punāgamiṃ.
kī'icc'evam'ādito dhātugaṇato nāpaccayo hoti kattari. kiṇāti, jināti, dhunāti, munāti, lunāti, punāti.

46775.meaning2: Chapter 15 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

46776.commentary: (SNa) n'atthi dāni pun'āvāso, devakāyasmi jālinī'ti… devate devakāyasmiṃ devasamūhe upapajjanavasena puna āvāso āvasanaṃ idāni mayhaṃ n'atthī'ti attho.

examples.text: n'atthi dāni pun'āvāso, devakāyasmi jālini, vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro, n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti.
ekā'hi dāṭhā tidivehi pūjitā, ekā pana gandhārapure mahīyati, kāliṅgarañño vijite pun'ekaṃ, ekaṃ pana nāgarājā maheti.
saṅg'ātigo maccujaho nirupadhi, pahāsi dukkhaṃ apunabbhavāya, atthaṅ'gato so na pun'eti, amohayī maccurājan'ti brūmī'ti.
anāgāmimaggena ye kilesā pahīnā, te kilese na pun'eti na pacceti na paccāgacchati. arahattamaggena ye kilesā pahīnā, te kilese na pun'eti na pacceti na paccāgacchatī'ti, pāraṅ'gato na pacceti.

46779.commentary: (THIa) na puno edisakaṃ bhavissatī'ti ito paraṃ evarūpaṃ anācāracaraṇaṃ na bhavissati, na karissāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: tassa ca viramāsi tāva'd'e, rāgo tattha khamāpayī ca naṃ, sotthi siyā brahmacārinī, na puno edisakaṃ bhavissati.

46780.notes: folk etymology puṃ + nāga, but in reality a Dravidian word

examples.text: kānanaṃ vanam'ogayha, vasāmi luddako ahaṃ, punnāgaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā, buddhaseṭṭhaṃ anussariṃ.
ko imaṃ pathaviṃ vicessati, yamalokañ'ca imaṃ sadevakaṃ, ko dhammapadaṃ sudesitaṃ, kusalo puppham'iva pacessati.
yo n'ājjhagamā bhavesu sāraṃ, vicinaṃ puppham'iva udumbaresu, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ye keci pupphagandhā, vassikaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, evam'evaṃ kho bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati.
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama… ye keci pupphagandhā, vassikaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, evam'eva bhoto gotamassa ovādo param'ajjadhammesu.

46789.meaning2: remover of withered flowers or rubbish, privy-cleaner
46789.commentary: (THa) ahosiṃ pupphachaḍḍako, hatthavikalassa hatthavāti viya upacāravasenāyaṃ imassa samaññā ahosi yadidaṃ pupphachaḍḍako'ti. milātapupphasantharavaṇṇatāya vā ukkārabhūmiyā evaṃ vutto. (JAa) pupphachaḍḍakan'ti vaccaṭṭhānasodhakaṃ.

examples.text: nīce kulamhi jāto'haṃ, daliddo appabhojano, hīnakammaṃ mamaṃ āsi, ahosiṃ pupphachaḍḍako.
hatthibandhaṃ assabandhaṃ, gopurisañ'ca maṇḍalaṃ, chavaḍāhakaṃ pupphachaḍḍakaṃ, sadhanam'anupatanti nāriyo.

46790.meaning1: rubbish removal; janitorial work; (comm) toilet cleaner

examples.text: hīnaṃ nāma kammaṃ, koṭṭhakakammaṃ, pupphachaḍḍakakammaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oññātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acittīkataṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma kammaṃ.
mama sudaṃ, bhikkhave, pitu nivesane pokkharaṇiyo kāritā honti. ekattha sudaṃ, bhikkhave, uppalaṃ pupphati, ekattha padumaṃ, ekattha puṇḍarīkaṃ, yāva'd'eva mam'atthāya.
yathā'pi padumaṃ nāma, sūriyaraṃsena pupphati, tath'ev'āhaṃ mahāvīra, buddharaṃsena pupphito.

46792.meaning1: wanting flowers; in need of blossoms

examples.text: kathaṃ pana, mārisa, rukkho rukkhadhamme ṭhito hotī'ti? idha, devate, rukkhassa mūlaṃ mūl'atthikā haranti, tacaṃ tac'atthikā haranti, pattaṃ patt'atthikā haranti, pupphaṃ pupph'atthikā haranti, phalaṃ phal'atthikā haranti.
vārena naṃ vahāmā'ti. mātā attano vāre pupphadāmaṃ viya naṃ ukkhipitvā ure nipajjāpetvā aṅkena vahitvā pituno deti. tassa taṃ gahetvā gamanakāle chātakato'pi balavatarā vedanā uppajji.
tasmiṃ samaye mūlato paṭṭhāya yāva aggasākhā sabbaṃ ekapāliphullaṃ ahosi, sākh'antarehi c'eva pupph'antarehi ca pañcavaṇṇā bhamaragaṇā nānappakārā ca sakuṇasaṅghā madhurassarena vikūjantā vicaranti.

46797.meaning1: flower offering; devotional offering of blossoms

examples.text: ayaṃ pupphapūjā buddha-paccekabuddha-aggasāvaka-mahāsāvaka-arahant'ādīnaṃ sabhāvasīlaṃ. aham'pi tesaṃ anuvattako homi.
tayo'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame tayo? gūthabhāṇī, pupphabhāṇī, madhubhāṇī. katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo gūthabhāṇī?
